records.claim_text: The Payroll Centre markets annual corporate support for the whole payroll team, rather than a personal membership seat.
records.limitations: Public provider description only; not independently observed service delivery or achieved commercial performance.

records.claim_text: The named Corporate plan is displayed at GBP 1,122 per year.
records.limitations: Displayed public list price on 29 October 2026, not a supplier quotation or validated JGA willingness to pay. Tax basis read with T1MC-C03. Not comparable to an event place, individual seat or commercial research licence.
records.unit: GBP per organisation per year for named Corporate plan

records.claim_text: The Payroll Centre business terms state that prices exclude VAT unless otherwise stated.
records.limitations: No VAT rate or gross payable total inferred. Offer-specific written terms may state otherwise.

records.claim_text: The offer includes helpdesk access and practical information, training and resource categories for payroll, HR and finance users.

locator.heading_or_clause: Support & Access / Resources & Knowledge / Training & Events

records.limitations: Comparison table uses graphical inclusion marks. Do not assign every listed feature to every tier from flattened text, or infer an audited complete entitlement schedule.

records.claim_text: The public FAQ says all payroll experience levels may use membership; the business terms retain discretion to accept or decline applications.
records.limitations: Admission is not equivalent to a vetted senior employer-only research panel. Secondary locator: tpc-terms.parsed.txt lines 48–54.

records.claim_text: Membership use is limited to named members and authorised users; the materials licence is limited and non-transferable, with redistribution and third-party use restricted.
records.limitations: Summary of public terms, not legal advice. A corporate member does not thereby acquire a research resale or client-publication licence.

records.claim_text: The public terms describe annual auto-renewal unless terminated, with a reminder before renewal.
records.limitations: Contract mechanism only, not observed renewals, achieved retention, future JGA revenue or a recommendation to copy these terms.

records.claim_text: The helpdesk terms describe staffed business-hours query handling and allow unusual or complex matters to be quoted separately as consultancy.
records.limitations: No guarantee of issue resolution, JGA service capacity or a need for JGA to build a technical advisory service.

records.claim_text: CIPP Full membership is an individual professional grade with qualification or payroll-management experience eligibility; the current tariff is unconfirmed.
records.limitations: Alternative screened only. Do not equate a personal grade with an organisational licence. The retained source at parsed line247 explicitly states price validity until 14 June 2026, so its displayed price is not promoted as a current price; another capture may differ.

records.claim_text: CIPP describes member-number-controlled, confidential access to payroll, pensions and reward technical advice.
records.limitations: Alternative screened only. Does not demonstrate a corporate membership package or imply access rights can be shared or resold.

records.claim_text: Human Capital Center Europe targets CHROs across EMEA with research insights, expert access, peer connections and ongoing team programming.
records.limitations: Concrete research-community offer, not proof of payroll-specialist coverage, demand for JGA, or a single standard entitlement bundle.

records.claim_text: The Conference Board separately describes Executive, C-Suite, Leadership Team and individual Council membership paths.
records.limitations: Do not merge the four paths into a single product; negotiated price, region and access rights remain unverified.

records.claim_text: Council seats are invitation-only, vetted individual memberships sold through an annual fee, with member-led topics, vendor-free exchanges and confidential meetings under the Chatham House Rule.

locator.heading_or_clause: A Candid Forum for Peer-Based Dialogue

records.limitations: Council layer only. Not a finding that Center membership includes a Council seat, that every member contributes research, or that a public paid research licence is included.

records.claim_text: The Conference Board website terms reserve rights and require separate permission for uses beyond the stated limited licence; employer-member employees may retain copies only within the licence or membership agreement.
records.limitations: Website terms only. Any negotiated membership or separate data/research licence must be inspected before relying on commercial redistribution rights.

records.claim_text: The website terms distinguish user submissions from private council discussion: content submitted to the sites is described as non-private and carries a broad usage grant.
records.limitations: Do not transfer website-submission terms to Council meetings or infer that meeting participation alone consents to attributable research publication.

records.claim_text: The Conference Board presents itself as a nonprofit think tank and business membership organisation.
records.limitations: No financial statements reviewed. Fee revenue mix, margins, sponsorship dependence and programme profitability are unknown.

analytical_inference_policy: Operational workload, JGA design lessons and buyer hypotheses are explicitly analyst inference in model notes, never reported as observed supplier performance.
